Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Widens the listening card by 20% for longer track and artist names.
- Bottom-aligns the title and artist text with the cover artwork.
- Increases the artist text size for improved readability.
